Steamed now runs on **Minecraft 1.20.1**, on Fabric and on Forge.

### New

- **Minecraft 1.20.1** on Fabric and **Forge** (Forge 47.x, the loader most 1.20.1 modpacks use). Hosting, the lobby
  screen, invites, the friends' lobbies list and the title-screen and pause-menu buttons work the same as on 1.21.1
  and 26.2

| Jar | Minecraft | Also needs |
|---|---|---|
| `steamed-fabric-0.2.1+26.2.jar` | 26.2 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-neoforge-0.2.1+26.2.jar` | 26.2 | Kotlin for Forge 6.4+ |
| `steamed-quilt-0.2.1+26.2.jar` | 26.2 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-fabric-0.2.1+1.21.1.jar` | 1.21, 1.21.1 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-neoforge-0.2.1+1.21.1.jar` | 1.21.1 | Kotlin for Forge 5.12+ |
| `steamed-fabric-0.2.1+1.20.1.jar` | 1.20.1 | Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin |
| `steamed-forge-0.2.1+1.20.1.jar` | 1.20.1 | Kotlin for Forge 4.12+ |

### Fixes

- The invite screen showed each friend's Steam status as a raw code name (`LookingToPlay`) and always said
  "(invited)" in English. Both are translated now, into every language Steamed ships

### Good to know

- 1.20.1, 1.21.1 and 26.2 players can't join each other. The friends' lobbies list greys out a lobby from a different
  Minecraft version and says why
- Not on 1.20.1: Quilt, NeoForge (barely used on 1.20.1), and player heads inside chat lines (join and leave lines still
  get the orange diamond)
- Joining a friend, kicking, voice chat and web maps across two Steam accounts haven't been tested on 1.20.1 yet
- Everyone in a lobby still needs the same Steamed version, so update together with your friends
